request: Car ad, 20 seconds, 4 scenes: the car in the desert; inside the car in the desert, its keychain; the same car drifting in Tokyo at night; inside the car in Tokyo, the same keychain.

doc.style: Photorealistic cinematic imagery with warm amber and cool neon palettes, crisp metallic textures, and sculpted high-contrast light.

assets.label: @car
assets.look: Sports coupe, 4.5 meters long, with a metallic silver body, black wheels, tinted glass, and an unbadged silhouette.

assets.label: @cabin
assets.look: Car cabin, 2.4 meters long and 1.5 meters wide, with black leather upholstery, brushed aluminum trim, and a central keychain attachment point.

assets.label: @keychain
assets.look: Keychain, 8 centimeters long, consisting of a polished steel ring, a short steel chain, and a circular red enamel charm.

assets.label: @desert
assets.look: Desert basin, approximately 5 kilometers across, with a flat sandy track, low dunes, and distant rocky ridges.

assets.label: @tokyo
assets.look: Tokyo street intersection, approximately 30 meters wide, bordered by dense commercial buildings with Japanese illuminated signage.

start.description: A wide, low three-quarter view places @car in the left third of @desert, pointing toward frame right. @car is traveling forward. Late-afternoon sunlight comes from the upper left; the weather is clear and still.

end.description: The same wide, low three-quarter view places @car in the right third of @desert, still pointing toward frame right and traveling forward. Late-afternoon sunlight remains upper left; the weather is clear and still.
